## Overview
Two people take part in three use cases.
## Use cases
- UC-001 Find a free room: staff look at the rooms free for a time. Derives from: PER-001, FR-001
- UC-002 Reserve a room: staff reserve a free room or are told the slot is taken. Derives from: PER-001, FR-001
- UC-003 Maintain rooms: the administrator adds, renames and retires rooms. Derives from: PER-002, FR-002
## Coverage check
None.
## Open questions
None.

problems: UC-003 derives from PER-009, which is not in the material you were given
PER-002 is not named in any item's 'Derives from:', and 'Coverage check' does not list it; cover it, or list it under 'Coverage check'
UC-003 names PER-009, which is not a persona you were given
